summary: Regression + stabilization sweep of ARSHNAZ (Persian RTL Vite+React+Firebase). Verified pharmacy-shortcuts row on Today dashboard (all 4 testids present + all 4 navigations work), Knowledge/Study/Review + Mind/Checkin/Thoughts/ABC/Socratic/Breathing/Crisis pages all load via SPA navigation without page errors, header theme toggle flips light/dark and persists localStorage 'arshnaz-theme', warm Arshnaz pink theme (class 'theme-arshnaz') is default. Applied 2 fixes: (a) sidebar top-level 'فارماسی' section was defined in code but omitted from DEFAULT_ORDER so it never rendered — added 'pharmacy' between 'do' and 'grow'; verified 4 pharmacy links now render top-level and expanded by default. (b) RichEditor registered @tiptap/extension-underline and @tiptap/extension-link alongside StarterKit v3 which already bundles both — removed the duplicate registrations and moved the link config into StarterKit.configure({link:{...}}). One issue remains: opening a new note still triggers ErrorBoundary with TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'cached') at _DOMSerializer.fromSchema … at Editor.getHTML — the duplicate-extension fix did NOT resolve it (Vite HMR confirmed to have picked up the file). Because the editor crashes at mount, the mobile 'More tools' dropdown, note persistence, and quote-item interaction could NOT be exercised.

ui_bugs.issue: Creating/opening a note crashes into ErrorBoundary with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading "cached")' inside prosemirror-model DOMSerializer.fromSchema, triggered from RichEditor useEffect line ~112 that calls editor.getHTML() right after useEditor. Removing duplicate Underline/Link extensions (StarterKit v3 already includes them) was applied but did NOT eliminate the crash — root cause is likely React StrictMode double-mount destroying the editor view (schema=null) before the effect runs, or another schema-initialization race. Consider wrapping the initial getHTML/setContent in a try/catch, guarding on !editor.isDestroyed && editor.view?.state?.schema, or moving initial content into useEditor's `content` option once (removing the useEffect entirely). Note is saved to Firestore (toast 'نوت ذخیره شد' fires) but the editor never renders.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix RichEditor.tsx 'DOMSerializer.fromSchema … cannot read properties of null (cached)' at mount. Try: (1) drop the useEffect at ~110-118 and rely on `content: initialHtml || markdownToHtml(initialMarkdown)` in useEditor options only; (2) or wrap `editor.getHTML()` inside `if (!editor.isDestroyed && editor.view)` and try/catch; (3) verify React.StrictMode isn't destroying the editor between passes — pass `immediatelyRender: false` and/or `shouldRerenderOnTransaction: false` per tiptap v3 SSR/StrictMode docs.
After fix, retest: create note, type content, apply blockquote via mobile editor-more-tools, reload, verify content persists in Firestore.
critical_code_review_comments: sidebar DEFAULT_ORDER in src/components/sidebar/SidebarNavSections.tsx was missing 'pharmacy' — section definition existed but was silently dropped. Recommend adding a unit assertion: every SECTION.id must be present in DEFAULT_ORDER (or derive DEFAULT_ORDER from SECTIONS.map(s=>s.id) with two sentinel prefixes) to prevent future regressions.

RichEditor.tsx imports @tiptap/extension-underline and @tiptap/extension-link alongside StarterKit v3 which already registers both (see /app/node_modules/@tiptap/starter-kit/src/starter-kit.ts). Duplicate marks/nodes can null out the ProseMirror schema cache. Fix applied (removed the two imports and moved link options into StarterKit.configure), but keep this pattern for any future extensions.

Multiple 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module' PAGEERRORs are still triggered by Cloudflare 429 on chunk requests during rapid page.goto(); ErrorBoundary currently just shows a static screen — consider auto-retry-with-backoff for dynamic import() failures.
Persistent capacitor warning: 'Capacitor plugin "ArshnazWidget" already registered. Cannot register plugins twice.' — noise only, but worth guarding the registration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The three focused regressions from this iteration: (a) pharmacy-shortcuts on Today — PASS as-shipped; (b) sidebar top-level 'فارماسی' — PASS after adding 'pharmacy' to DEFAULT_ORDER (existing users may still have stale sidebar_order_v1 in localStorage; loadOrder() does append missing ids, so it should self-heal); (c) mobile editor-more-tools — testid & md:hidden confirmed but interaction BLOCKED by an unrelated RichEditor crash that must be fixed first (see action items). All Knowledge/Study and Mind pages load fine via SPA nav — do NOT use rapid page.goto() loops or you will hit Cloudflare 429s; prefer clicking sidebar links or history.pushState + popstate. Login flow, theme toggle, and pharma-shortcut nav are all stable.
rca_of_the_issue: Two root causes were found and one fixed. (1) Sidebar 'فارماسی' invisible → SECTIONS[] included id:'pharmacy' but DEFAULT_ORDER = ['__folders','__tags','do','grow','mind','me'] omitted it, and AppSidebar renders sections in `order` only; fixed by inserting 'pharmacy' after 'do'. (2) Note editor crash → StarterKit v3 already registers Underline and Link marks; RichEditor was ALSO registering @tiptap/extension-underline and @tiptap/extension-link, causing duplicate mark specs and (typically) a null ProseMirror schema; the duplicate imports were removed and link options moved into StarterKit.configure({link:{…}}), but the crash persists in practice, suggesting a secondary trigger (likely React.StrictMode double-mount destroying the editor.view before the useEffect at RichEditor.tsx L110-118 calls editor.getHTML(), yielding schema=null and DOMSerializer.fromSchema failing on schema.cached). Recommended mitigation is to drop that useEffect (initial content already supplied via useEditor's `content` option) and/or guard with `if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) return`; consider also `immediatelyRender: false` for tiptap v3.
